rounds.title: Variants one axis at a time
rounds.note: Q72: one group of rows per axis (appearance, fill, labelMode, size), each row one value with the other axes at default, interaction states in the columns.

a.note: Each axis row draws the field empty with a hint, so the label modes show the label at rest and floated on focus.

b.note: Each axis row draws the field with a value, so the rows show the text and the floated label at rest.
